title: A Margolus-Levitin speed limit for observables: mean energy bounds expectation-value change quadratically
summary: The Mandelstam-Tamm and Margolus-Levitin quantum speed limits bound how fast a state evolves, using the energy variance and the mean energy above the ground state. Speed limits on observables -- the change of an expectation value -- have so far used the variance (the Mandelstam-Tamm / quantum-Fisher-information lineage); the mean energy has not been brought to bear on the change of in a fixed state.
